Stella Nakaweesi/Lead Designer & Developer at STEZ TECHNOLOGIES LTD | BSc. Accounting, Makerere University  

Stella is a self-taught technologist and product builder passionate about using AI and design to solve real-world problems in Africa. After graduating from Makerere University with a Bachelor’s in Accounting, she followed her passion for Information Technology and now leads design and development at STEZ TECHNOLOGIES LTD.  

She has built products including STEZ WILL VAULT, STEZ LANDLORD
